title: The Unexpected Promise
author: Rosalind Brightwater
blurb: Zephyrine Thornbury, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
